# powerdns_zone_metadata (Resource)

One metadata kind on a zone, such as `ALLOW-AXFR-FROM` or `NOTIFY-DNSUPDATE`.

One kind per resource, deliberately. PowerDNS sets `SOA-EDIT-API` on every zone it creates, so a resource owning the whole collection would try to delete it on every apply. What this provider does not manage, it does not touch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One kind per resource, deliberately. PowerDNS sets SOA-EDIT-API on every zone
# it creates, so a resource owning the whole collection would try to delete it
# on every apply. What this provider does not manage, it does not touch.

resource "powerdns_zone_metadata" "transfers" {
  zone   = powerdns_zone.example.id
  kind   = "ALLOW-AXFR-FROM"
  values = ["192.0.2.0/24", "2001:db8::/32"]
}

# SOA-EDIT-API and API-RECTIFY are not addressable here: PowerDNS lists them
# under a zone's metadata and answers 422 when they are read or written by
# name, because they exist as attributes of the zone. Use powerdns_zone.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) The metadata kind. PowerDNS reserves the names it documents and accepts an `X-` prefix for anything else.
- `values` (List of String) The values for this kind. Every kind is multi-valued in the API, even the ones that only ever hold one item.
- `zone` (String) The zone this metadata belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<zone>/<kind>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import powerdns_zone_metadata.transfers 'example.com./ALLOW-AXFR-FROM'
```
